explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the foundation of all laws, including the sanctity of marriage.
A united life between a man and a woman that God has joined together according to His will from the creation of the world.
A legal or social dissolution of a marital bond, which Jesus permits only in cases of sexual immorality but does not generally encourage.
Breaking faithfulness in marriage through sexual relations outside the covenant between a man and a woman.
Worthy goods or material possessions that can become an obstacle to following Jesus fully, as the rich young ruler experienced.
This is God's rule over humanity where righteousness and eternal life reign, something one must be willing to give up everything to enter.
People who serve others with humility and devotion, an attitude Jesus encourages His disciples to have rather than seeking power or honor.
